name: nirberko
description: Nir Berko's agent skills and output styles, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: nirberko-skills
plugins.description: Skills for understanding code you didn't write (learn, explain), catching your team's review comments before they do (cr) and posting them on the PR (cr-post), repairing unverified commit signatures (verify-commits), writing a design doc a reviewer can follow (tech-design), and re-saying a long answer in two paragraphs (tldr), plus the Plain output style.
